primary_reference.title: System and method providing policy based data center network automation
source_characterization: Detects compute events including a VM instantiation request and generates a registration event.
Retrieves policy information and performs policy-based determination regarding event authorization and data-center resource allocation.
Configures relevant data-center services if the detected compute event is authorized.

The disclosure includes both request-triggered language and embodiments/claims in which detection can occur in response to hypervisor instantiation of a VM; this ambiguity is preserved rather than resolved in favor of GBI.

context_reference.title: Resource and admission control functions in Next Generation Networks
source_characterization: Discloses single-, two-, and three-phase resource-control schemes.
Expressly separates authorization, reservation, and commitment in some schemes.
Included for provenance and claim-boundary context only; CPA_PRIOR_ART is not allowed to import ITU sequencing unless explicitly identified as an assumption in a later campaign version.
